name: 1 Chibi B
design: CHARACTER: CHIBI B. The supplied image is a design-reference source, not artwork to copy at its existing adult proportions. Redesign that same auditor robot to be MUCH cuter. Preserve its rounded-square off-white head, dark rounded-rectangle visor, mint accountant eyeshade, circular mint-trimmed ear discs and a single offset thin antenna with round mint tip on the robot's right (viewer-left). Replace the single horizontal eye bar with TWO BIG DISTINCT luminous dot eyes. Make the head approximately 1.3 times the height of the torso-and-hip body combined, and wider than the entire tiny torso. The combined stubby legs and feet are shorter than half the head height. Neck almost hidden. Tiny rounded bean torso, short pill arms, simple little boots, reduced navy joints. The silhouette is top-heavy and rounded, not tall, muscular, stiff or adult. Keep exactly this construction in all four poses.
prompt:
Create one polished 3D mascot character pose sheet for an auditor website, on a completely flat solid chroma-key magenta #FF00FF background. Wide landscape sheet, approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Exactly FOUR full-body views of ONE IDENTICAL character in a SINGLE horizontal row, left to right, with four equal-width invisible cells. Leave generous clear magenta gaps between poses and padding around all extremities. Same camera, same anatomical scale, same materials and character construction in all four views. Near-front gentle three-quarter view. All parts, antennae, tools and action gestures entirely inside their own cell.

BRAND AND TONE: extremely cute chibi proportions, oversized expressive head, compact body, soft pillowy rounded edges and tiny simple mitten hands. A friendly, observant, careful professional auditor with a little personality. Calm competence with cheerful expressions. Matte warm off-white shell, mint #3ddc97 accents, dark navy #111a20 visor and details. Smooth clean softly modeled 3D forms, broad simple surfaces, few large readable details. A tiny mint accountant's eyeshade with a short projecting visor is clearly attached above the face in every pose. The digital screen face has only TWO LARGE glowing mint dot eyes; they change shape for expression. Use eyes, head tilt and gesture for expression; no mouth needed. Design must remain readable at only 72 pixels tall. Stubby limbs, no long adult legs or fingers, no exposed complex joints, no intricate machinery. Each pose includes the same small rubber stamp with mint handle/collar and a dark navy rectangular rubber base; the rubber stamp must be visibly held, not floating.

FOUR POSES IN EXACT LEFT-TO-RIGHT ORDER:
1. IDLE: upright relaxed attentive posture, two big round glowing dot eyes, holding the little rubber stamp down beside the body.
2. INSPECT: leaning forward a little with focused curious eyes, holding one simple navy-rimmed magnifying glass in one hand while keeping the rubber stamp in the other hand. Keep the face legible.
3. STAMP-DOWN: a decisive downward stamping strike; the hand grips the stamp firmly against an imaginary flat surface at the feet/bottom level. Body leans into the action, eyes are two clear squeezed chevrons > < conveying cute effort. Keep the stamp visible. No impact symbols, no drawn lines, no extra stamp copies.
4. APPROVE: happy glowing eyes shaped ^ ^, a clear little thumbs-up with one mitten hand and the same rubber stamp held in the other, a delighted but careful little auditor.

BACKGROUND/EXCLUSIONS: background is pure uniform #FF00FF edge to edge, including all gaps. NO shadows on the background, NO ground or contact shadows, no floor, no horizon, no platforms apart from the character's own body, no gradients in the background, no text, letters, numerals, digits, logos, watermarks, dividers, labels, checkmarks, speech bubbles or decorative symbols. Do not paint any magenta or pink on the character. Gentle surface shading is allowed only on the character itself. Exactly four separated poses, not a collage or a multi-row grid.

name: 2 Calc
design: CHARACTER: CALC. A tiny boxy pocket-calculator robot with a very large soft rounded-square upper head/screen and a smaller short calculator-keypad belly. The upper screen/head occupies about 60 percent of the entire character height, with two enormous simple mint dot eyes on a navy face screen. A tiny mint accountant's eyeshade clips to the top of the screen bezel. Below it, a compact belly has exactly SIX broad blank rounded-square off-white keys, in two rows of three, on a subtle mint recessed panel. All keys are completely blank, without numbers, letters or icons. These six keys and their layout stay identical in every pose. Short mint-trimmed feet and tiny side mitten arms attach to the compact calculator body. No antenna, no ears, no tail. Very low rounded calculator silhouette, readable broad keys, no complicated gadgets. It is an embodied auditor character rather than an ordinary inanimate calculator. Keep exactly this construction in all four poses.

name: 3 Hover
design: CHARACTER: HOVER. A round floating egg/ball auditor robot. Almost the entire body is one very large smooth plump off-white egg with a huge dark navy screen face on the upper front; the screen has two enormous luminous mint dot eyes. A tiny mint accountant's eyeshade clips just above that screen. One short offset antenna with a mint round tip grows from the top. Two tiny mitten arms emerge from the sides of the egg. The large egg is both the head and the compact body; no separate torso. NO legs and NO feet in any pose. The underside has one small mint thruster nozzle and a short compact mint exhaust glow immediately beneath it. The exhaust is confined to a small clean mint teardrop shape with no magenta, long rays or diffuse haze; no glow spills onto the background. It hovers consistently a little above the imaginary ground. In the downward stamping pose the little arm reaches down so the held stamp reaches that imaginary ground while the egg still floats. Keep exactly this construction in all four poses.

name: 5 Stampy
design: CHARACTER: STAMPY. The robot's whole BODY IS A RUBBER STAMP. Its oversized handle-shaped head is a broad soft off-white mushroom/pear-shaped stamp handle with a navy rounded face screen on its front and TWO BIG glowing mint dot eyes. The head/handle occupies about 60 percent of the total character height. A tiny mint accountant's eyeshade projects over the face screen from the top of the handle. The handle narrows into one very short off-white stem that connects directly to a wide soft rounded-rectangular mint stamp base with a navy rubber sole. The broad stamp base IS its feet; absolutely no separate legs, shoes, humanoid torso or belly. Two very short off-white mitten arms emerge from the narrow neck just above the mint base. In addition to BEING a stamp-shaped robot it holds one separate miniature handheld rubber stamp in its hand for each of the specified gestures. This little tool is clearly smaller than its own body. The screen must be large and charming; it should unmistakably read as a living rubber-stamp auditor rather than a robot standing on a platform. Keep exactly this construction in all four poses.
